routing.ferries: none: a drive time never includes a boat
routing.rounding: minutes to the nearest whole minute; counts use the unrounded time

area.source: INE indicator 0008350, area of the territorial units (km²), from the Direção-Geral do Território (CAOP)
area.note: Field area_km2. Official area of the municipality.

er.source: List of 56 general public hospitals with an emergency department (4 more, children's and maternity hospitals, are listed but not used) (SNS/ULS, SESARAM, the Azores hospitals), compiled per ULS on 2026-11-02; points from OpenStreetMap; each ULS checked against the SNS open-data file of emergency attendances 2026
er.note: The building-level SNS list of emergency departments could not be downloaded; basic emergency services in health centres are missing. er_cand = a nearer OSM hospital tagged emergency=yes that the list does not hold (unverified, operator's decision). Islands: no road route crosses the sea (the routing has no ferries), so a place on an island with none of these gets null.

cs.source: OpenStreetMap (Portugal extract of 2026-11-09, download.openstreetmap.fr): health centres by name (Centro de Saúde, USF, UCSP, Extensão de Saúde, Unidade de Saúde)
cs.note: 921 units. The name is OSM's (often the building), not the ERS register's unit name. Islands: no road route crosses the sea (the routing has no ferries), so a place on an island with none of these gets null.

ph.source: The hospital groups' own lists of units (CUF, Luz, Lusíadas, Trofa Saúde, HPA; 2026-11-02) plus OSM private hospitals
ph.note: 77 units; some are small units, not full hospitals; not every one has an emergency service. ph_n20 = within 20 minutes. Islands: no road route crosses the sea (the routing has no ferries), so a place on an island with none of these gets null.

pharm.source: OpenStreetMap (Portugal extract of 2026-11-09, download.openstreetmap.fr): amenity=pharmacy inside the municipality's boundary
pharm.note: 2696 pharmacies in OSM (Portugal has about 2 900): a floor, not a census. 0 in OSM is shown as null.

isch.source: List of international schools (school sites and a third-party directory, 2026-11-02) plus OSM schools whose name says international
isch.note: 48 schools; cur and lang are null where the curriculum was not checked. isch_n30 = within 30 minutes. Islands: no road route crosses the sea (the routing has no ferries), so a place on an island with none of these gets null.

psch.source: OpenStreetMap (Portugal extract of 2026-11-09, download.openstreetmap.fr): amenity=school, private by tag or by name (Colégio, Externato)
psch.note: 484 schools. OSM does not say which cycles a school teaches, so this count includes primary-only private schools and misses unmapped ones; the official register (DGEEC) needs the operator. International schools are not in this count.

sec.source: OpenStreetMap (Portugal extract of 2026-11-09, download.openstreetmap.fr): amenity=school whose name says Secundária, not private

beach.source: APA identified bathing waters 2026 (points), EEA bathing-water status 2024 (category), Associação Bandeira Azul awarded sites 2026 (flag)
beach.licence: APA: no restrictions stated; EEA: reuse with attribution
beach.note: Nearest sea bathing water by road: EEA category coastal, or transitional (river mouths and lagoons open to the sea, 26 of them; cat says which). beach_flag = nearest with a 2026 Blue Flag; beach_n20 = how many within 20 minutes; beach_inland = nearest river or lake bathing water. A bathing water more than 1 km from a road gets no drive time. Islands: no road route crosses the sea (the routing has no ferries), so a place on an island with none of these gets null.

air.source: OpenStreetMap (Portugal extract of 2026-11-09, download.openstreetmap.fr): passenger terminal of the 14 airports with scheduled passenger flights (LIS, OPO, FAO, FNC, PXO and nine in the Azores)
air.note: Regional airfields (Bragança, Vila Real, Viseu, Cascais, Portimão) and Beja are not counted. Islands: no road route crosses the sea (the routing has no ferries), so a place on an island with none of these gets null.

rail.source: OpenStreetMap (Portugal extract of 2026-11-09, download.openstreetmap.fr): stations where the route relations of CP Alfa Pendular, Intercidades and the Porto–Vigo international train stop
rail.note: 77 stations. No railway on the islands: null.

food.source: MICHELIN Guide Portugal selection as listed on 2026-11-10 (mich_n30, mich_star_n30); OSM marketplaces named Mercado (mkt_n20); OSM amenity=restaurant in the municipality (rest_n) over the 2021 census population (rest_per_1k)
food.note: 201 Michelin-listed restaurants, 418 markets, 19290 restaurants in OSM. Counts describe what is listed and mapped, not quality. OSM restaurant mapping is uneven between municipalities.

golf.source: The map's golf data (prompt 33): open courses
golf.note: 78 courses. golf_n30 = within 30 minutes. Islands: no road route crosses the sea (the routing has no ferries), so a place on an island with none of these gets null.

museum.source: OpenStreetMap (Portugal extract of 2026-11-09, download.openstreetmap.fr): tourism=museum and amenity=theatre, named
museum.note: 1229 museums and 381 theatres. cult_n20 = both within 20 minutes.
